title: Numeral Studio Feature Manifest
description: Contract for a single scaffolder feature folder under scripts/features/. The setup script (scripts/setup.mjs) reads these manifests, prompts the user, and applies selected features.

id.description: Unique feature identifier. Kebab-case. Must match folder name. Conventionally <category>-<provider>, e.g. 'auth-clerk' or 'db-drizzle-neon'.

category.description: Functional category this feature belongs to. The scaffolder groups prompts by category and (by convention) only allows one feature per category at a time.

label.description: Human-readable display name shown in the setup prompt (e.g. 'Clerk').

description.description: One-line summary shown beneath the prompt. Plain prose, no markdown.

dependencies.description: npm runtime dependencies to add to the project's package.json. Each entry is a full spec including version range (e.g. '@clerk/nextjs@^6'). Unversioned specs are allowed but discouraged.

devDependencies.description: npm dev dependencies. Same shape as 'dependencies'.

envKeys.description: Environment variables required or optional for this feature. The scaffolder appends these to .env.example with the description as a comment.

files.description: Files to copy from the feature's files/ subfolder into the generated project. The 'to' path supports '${PROJECT_NAME}' substitution.

readmeSection.description: Markdown content appended to the generated project README under a '## <label>' heading. Should describe how to use the feature, env keys to set, and any post-install steps.

postInstall.description: Optional shell commands to run after 'bun install'. Use sparingly; prefer files and readmeSection. Each command runs in the project root with the project's PATH.

conflicts.description: Other feature ids that cannot be selected together with this one (e.g. 'auth-clerk' conflicts with 'auth-kinde').

requires.description: Other feature ids that must be selected together with this one (e.g. an analytics feature might require a flags feature).

depSpec.description: An npm dependency spec. Accepts '<name>', '<name>@<range>', '@scope/<name>', or '@scope/<name>@<range>'. Range can be any valid semver range, tag, url, or 'workspace:*'.

name.description: Environment variable name. UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. If 'public' is true the name MUST start with 'NEXT_PUBLIC_'.

required.description: Whether the variable must be set for the feature to function. Optional vars still appear in .env.example but commented out.

description.description: Short comment written next to the entry in .env.example.

public.description: If true, the value is exposed to the client bundle. Must use a 'NEXT_PUBLIC_' prefix and the scaffolder writes it to the client-safe section of env.ts.

from.description: Path inside the feature folder's files/ directory. POSIX separators. Must not start with '/' or contain '..'.

to.description: Destination path relative to the project root. POSIX separators. May contain '${PROJECT_NAME}'. Must not start with '/' or contain '..'.

overwrite.description: If true, an existing file at 'to' will be replaced. If false, the scaffolder skips and warns.
